//OnlineShopping
package Practice;
import java.util.*;
public class OnlineShoppingCartSystem {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		
		char moreCustomer;
		
		while (true) {
			System.out.println("=== Online Shopping Cart ===");
			
			int totalamt=0;
			
			int n;
			do {
				System.out.print("Enter no. of products to buy (atlest 1): ");
				n=sc.nextInt();
			}while (n<1);
			
			for(int i=1; i<=n; i++) {
				System.out.println("Select product "+i+" :");
				System.out.println("1. Mobile - Rs.2500");
				System.out.println("2. Laptop - Rs. 4500");
				System.out.println("3. Headphone - Rs. 1000");
				System.out.println("4. Charger - Rs 500");
				System.out.println("5. Smart Watch - Rs 3000");
				
				int choice=sc.nextInt();
				
				switch(choice) {
				case 1:
					totalamt+=2500;
					break;
				case 2:
					totalamt+=4500;
					break;
				case 3:
					totalamt+=1000;
					break;
				case 4:
					totalamt+=500;
					break;
				case 5:
					totalamt+=3000;
					break;
				default:
					System.out.println("Invalid choice!!! No item added.");
				}
			}
			
			if(totalamt>5000) {
				int discount=totalamt*10/100;
				totalamt-=discount;
				System.out.println("Congratulation! You got 10% discount.");
			}
			
			System.out.println("Final bill amount: Rs - "+totalamt);
			
			System.out.print("Is there any other customer? (Y/N): ");
			moreCustomer=sc.next().charAt(0);
			
			if(moreCustomer=='n' || moreCustomer=='N') {
				System.out.println("Shop closed!!! Thank you.");
				break;
			}
			
		}
		sc.close();

	}

}
